text_en: The spirit lifted me up and brought me to the east gate of the house of the Lord , which faces east. There, at the entrance of the gateway, were twenty-five men; among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur, and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, officials of the people.
text_cn: 以后，神力把我提起，把我带到上主圣殿东面的东门那里。看，在大门口有二十五个人，我看见在他们中有阿组尔的儿子雅匝尼雅和贝纳雅的儿子培拉提雅，他们是民众的首领。

text_en: He said to me, “Mortal, these are the men who devise iniquity and who give wicked counsel in this city;
text_cn: 上主向我说：“人子，在这城中图谋不轨，出坏主意的就是这些人。

text_en: they say, ‘The time is not near to build houses; this city is the pot, and we are the meat. ’
text_cn: 他们说：房屋不是刚建筑不久吗？城是锅，我们是肉。

text_en: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, O mortal. ”
text_cn: 为此你要发言反对他们；人子，发言吧！”

text_en: Then the spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and he said to me, “Say, Thus says the Lord : This is what you think, O house of Israel; I know the things that come into your mind.
text_cn: 上主的神临于我，向我说：“你要说：上主这样说：以色列家，你们所说过的话，心中想的什么，我都知道。

text_en: You have killed many in this city, and have filled its streets with the slain.
text_cn: 你们在此城中杀害了许多人，街市上满了伤亡的人。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : The slain whom you have placed within it are the meat, and this city is the pot; but you shall be taken out of it.
text_cn: 为此吾主上主这样说：你们在城内所杀害的人是肉，城是锅，但你们都要由城中赶出去。

text_en: You have feared the sword; and I will bring the sword upon you, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 你们怕刀剑，我必使刀剑临于你们 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: I will take you out of it and give you over to the hands of foreigners, and execute judgments upon you.
text_cn: 我要把你们由城中赶出，把你们交于外人手中，在你们身上实行惩罚。

text_en: You shall fall by the sword; I will judge you at the border of Israel. And you shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 你们要丧身刀下；我必要在以色列边境上惩罚你们；如此，你们要承认我是上主。

text_en: This city shall not be your pot, and you shall not be the meat inside it; I will judge you at the border of Israel.
text_cn: 这城为你们决不是锅，你们也决不是其中的肉；我必要在以色列边境上惩罚你们。

text_en: Then you shall know that I am the Lord , whose statutes you have not followed, and whose ordinances you have not kept, but you have acted according to the ordinances of the nations that are around you. ”
text_cn: 如此你们必承认我是上主，因为你们没有遵行我的法令，没有实行我的法律，却照你们四邻异民的法律去行。”

text_en: Now, while I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, cried with a loud voice, and said, “Ah Lord God ! will you make a full end of the remnant of Israel? ”
text_cn: 我正在讲预言的时候，贝纳雅的儿子培拉提雅死了；我遂伏地掩面，高声哀呼说：“哎！吾主上主，你要灭尽以色列的遗民吗？”

text_en: Then the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, your kinsfolk, your own kin, your fellow exiles, the whole house of Israel, all of them, are those of whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, “They have gone far from the Lord ; to us this land is given for a possession. ”
text_cn: “人子，耶路撒冷的居民论及你的同胞兄弟，同你一起被掳的人，即以色列全家族的人，这样说：他们远离了上主，这地应归于我们占有了。

text_en: Therefore say: Thus says the Lord God : Though I removed them far away among the nations, and though I scattered them among the countries, yet I have been a sanctuary to them for a little while in the countries where they have gone.
text_cn: 为此你应宣讲说：吾主上主这样说：我虽迁移他们，远至异民之中，将他们分散到各国，但在他们所到的地方，我暂时仍是他们的圣所。

text_en: Therefore say: Thus says the Lord God : I will gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
text_cn: 因此你应宣讲：吾主上主这样说：我要从各民族聚集你们，由你们分散所到的各国中召集你们，把以色列地域再赐给你们。

text_en: When they come there, they will remove from it all its detestable things and all its abominations.
text_cn: 他们一回到那里，必灭绝那里的偶像，铲除那里的一切丑恶的事。

text_en: I will give them one heart, and put a new spirit within them; I will remove the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
text_cn: 我必赐给他们另一颗心，在他们脏腑放上另一种精神；拿走他们铁石的心，给他们换上一颗血肉的心，

text_en: so that they may follow my statutes and keep my ordinances and obey them. Then they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
text_cn: 为使他们遵行我的法令，谨守我的法律，而一一实行：如此他们要作我的百姓，我要作他们的天主。

text_en: But as for those whose heart goes after their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their deeds upon their own heads, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 至于那些心中仍随从偶像和丑恶之事的人，我要把他们的行为归在他们的头上 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: Then the cherubim lifted up their wings, with the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.
text_cn: 那时，革鲁宾展开了翅膀，轮子也随着转动，以色列天主的光荣停在他们之上。

text_en: And the glory of the Lord ascended from the middle of the city, and stopped on the mountain east of the city.
text_cn: 上主的光荣由城中升起，停在城东的山上。

text_en: The spirit lifted me up and brought me in a vision by the spirit of God into Chaldea, to the exiles. Then the vision that I had seen left me.
text_cn: 神力把我提起，在异象中，即在天主的神力中，把我带到加色丁，充军的人那里。我所见的异象就在我面前消失了。

text_en: And I told the exiles all the things that the Lord had shown me.
text_cn: 我遂向充军的人讲述上主给我显示的一切事。
